text:
Lina (Design): exploring a 'Clip' export flow — lightweight export of the selected span/window (vs full trace). trying to get buy-in on labels + a11y. mock: https://imgur.com/clip-mock Marco - Eng: Clip is fine. backend note: we produce HAR + trace.json + a small metadata.json. front-end can bundle them into a single .zip. Diane PM: support asks for a single-click "Quick-share" that copies a one-line paste (trace id + short link) and prepares the Clip download in background. saves time during triage. Ivy Support: huge +1. often need to paste into Slack or ticket right away, then attach files. Quick-share = timesaver. Lina (Design): proposal: toolbar shows a tiny clip scissor icon. primary click = Clip menu with: "Download clip (.har)" and "Quick-share (copy id + link)". add secondary chevron -> "Download clip (.json)". mobile opens a bottom sheet. a11y-checker: accessibility notes: clip menu must be reachable by keyboard (Enter to open, Arrow keys nav), menu role semantics, and file types announced ("HAR format, contains network + timing"). ensure focus trap in bottom sheet. Marco - Eng: implement copy formats client-side. Quick-share will copy: `Trace — /trace/` and queue zip prep. we can return a toast when ready with a download link. Lina (Design): wording for quick-share toast: "Clip ready — click to download or paste the copied link". aria-live polite for that. Ivy Support: when copying, please include selection start/end timestamps and a one-line header like: `Trace 7f4c2a — 2026-03-22T15:12:03Z (12.3s-18.7s)` so it can be used as ticket subject. Diane PM: decision: Quick-share copy = short id + permalink + selected time-range in parentheses. default download label = "Download clip (.har)". show small text "HAR (network + timing)" under the action for clarity. Marco - Eng: keyboard shortcuts: K toggle playback, J/L small scrub, Shift+J/L big scrub. we'll expose hints on hover and settings. avoid Space global because of focus conflicts. a11y-checker: timestamp readout: use aria-live="polite" and speak like "12 seconds, 300 milliseconds". throttle announcements while dragging (>=250ms). also consider prefers-reduced-motion for scrubber animation. Lina (Design): good catch about reduced motion. we'll add motion-reduced variant and ensure focus rings meet contrast. color token callout: use token "focus-accent-500" with 3:1 border but add 2px outline to reach 4.5:1 on light backgrounds. Ivy Support: copy stack option please — inline "Copy stack" beside collapsed frames. default copy = full stack + one-line header. optional markdown format in the export submenu. Marco - Eng: will add clipboard formats: plain and markdown. also will throttle clipboard write confirmations and announce via a status region. snippet: "
Copied clip link to clipboard
". Diane PM: mobile specifics: clip action launches full-sheet with selection scrubbers and checkboxes for file types. Quick-share will copy short link and open native share sheet. a11y-checker: ensure bottom sheet has `aria-modal=true` and that keyboard focus is trapped. native share interactions should still be reachable for assistive tech. Marco - Eng: perf note: timeline ticks will be virtualized, scrubber maps to index. large traces won't render all ticks. we'll also offload heavy encoding to a worker when zipping. Lina (Design): final checklist I propose: 1) Clip primary = Download clip (.har) + Quick-share copy; 2) Inline "Copy stack" for collapsed stacks (plain + markdown); 3) keyboard K/J/L shortcuts with in-UI hints; 4) timestamp aria-live polite with 250ms throttle and natural language formatting; 5) reduced-motion support; 6) focus ring color adjustment for contrast; 7) mobile bottom sheet for clip/export. any objections? Ivy Support: no objections. excited to try Quick-share. ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-clip/1992456789 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Lina (Design): pairing review 4pm PT. will post updated frames after that. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
